notes: Agents show HTML pages inline in threads (T3 Code's html_preview / html_render, ported): a Claude or Codex thread can build one self-contained page (chart, table, diagram, collage, mockup), check it with html_preview — a PNG screenshot, contentHeight and the page's console output with page.html:N locations, rendered in a hidden offscreen BrowserWindow on its own partition that only reaches public hosts — then publish it with html_render. The page is stored under userData/html-renders/<thread>/<page>.html with local images inlined as data URIs (10 MiB each, 25 MiB a page) and a theme bootstrap in its head, served as tempcode-asset://page/…, and shown where the call completed as a borderless sandboxed iframe (never same-origin) at the height main measured for the column width, following the app's theme live and opening full-window from a hover button. Deleting a thread deletes its pages. Shared logic in src/shared/htmlRender.ts; tools beside app_list_threads in apptools.ts and the Codex bridge (PNG as an MCP image part, bytes kept out of the transcript); the "Showing visuals" paragraph in every thread's app-tools note and the orchestrator prompt. Tests: htmlRender (shared, main), htmlPreviewPolicy, assets, apptools, app-bridge, codex, sessions-index, htmlRenderBlock, transcriptActivity, appTool, HtmlRenderFrame.dom.
